review_kind: Independent source, meaning and dignity review
subject: fort-sill-apache-us-ok-nm
decision: Three proposed bounded context notes and own links are source-supported as attributed history and program goals. No mandatory correction or unresolved P1/P2 finding. Normal hold, build and publication gates remain required.

findings.finding: Independent reading of retained history HTML confirms permanent-home promise, later pressure to leave as a condition of freedom, a Mescalero invitation urged by government agents, and scattered allotments. Proposed copy frames divergent paths under coercion, not unconstrained choice or interchangeable modern governments.
Source states mid-1970s and then constitution approval without an exact year. Proposed copy correctly preserves the broad period and does not invent1976 or an exact approval date.

History supports land acquisition in Oklahoma and New Mexico/Arizona homeland areas. Government source distinguishes supreme General Council authority from Business Committee administrative responsibilities. Broad shared-governing-responsibility wording is supported and does not claim legal equivalence or present officeholders.

Source supports history/resource collection, Chiricahua language teaching purpose, and learning-material development. Proposed paragraph explicitly treats the undated page as program purposes and does not verify present classes, timing or outcomes.

All notes and links bind only to Fort Sill Apache canonical profile; no merger with Mescalero government, named Chiricahua Apache Nation community or broader Chiricahua people. No personal contacts, classes' cultural instructions, sacred sites, imagery, ancestors or current legal outcomes imported.

nonblocking_precision_suggestions.suggestion: If refining further, state that the Mescalero invitation was urged by government agents, as the source says. This makes the coercive federal role explicit; current copy already acknowledges coercion and is not false.
For stricter goal-only wording, replace This living work with These preservation goals. Existing explicit undated-program caveat already prevents a current-operation claim.

hold_review.source_scope: All six proposed notes/resources bind the exact existing Fort Sill Apache ID. No separately named third-party people are exposed outside those bound records.
hold_review.limits: This document review does not replace a rendered fixture showing the real canonical hide_nation/takedown path suppresses headings, paragraphs, resources and relationship links. Root must retain/run existing hold acceptance checks. No new restoration or approval is implied.
